edges.reason: tx.origin is read inside the MatrixETF constructor to derive the privileged owner address.
Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, enabling ownership takeover through phishing.
Constructor grants allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1) to the transaction origin.
The owner state variable gates the privileged delegate function.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside delegate.
Owner-controlled function reaches an arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
The list function is only gated by the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside list.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is evaluated with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
list performs an unchecked external call to protectionFromBots before writing balances.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when checking the allowance of _from.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked subtraction and addition.
transferFrom decreases the allowance with an unchecked subtraction.
The checkBots modifier executes an external call before transferFrom applies any state change.
The external bot-protection call can re-enter transferFrom before balances and allowances are updated.
The modifier performs a low-level call into protectionFromBots, exposing an external callback surface.
transfer simply forwards all arguments to transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the forwarded transfer.
approve writes directly into the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the owner key used when writing the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping of both parties.
transferFrom mutates the allowance mapping when the caller is not the source.
list overwrites balanceOf entries of the contract and of arbitrary addresses.
list invokes routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
The constructor computes the Uniswap pair through pairOfTokens.
The pairOfTokens return value is stored in the uniPair state variable.
The constructor grants the Uniswap router an unlimited allowance.
list executes a loop that assigns arbitrary balances without any supply accounting.
The balance assignment loop writes into the balanceOf mapping.
The checkBots modifier calls into the external protectionFromBots contract.
list calls into the external protectionFromBots contract with attacker-influenced data.
The low-level call inside list can re-enter list before the balance loop completes.
The _from parameter is forwarded to the external bot-protection call.
The _to parameter is forwarded to the external bot-protection call.
The _value parameter is forwarded to the external bot-protection call.
The delegatecall target is taken directly from the caller-supplied parameter a.
The delegatecall calldata is taken directly from the caller-supplied parameter b.
The _reallyGoHere array is ABI-encoded and sent to protectionFromBots.
The _amounts array supplies the arbitrary balances written by the loop.
_numList is an unrestricted value used for liquidity and contract balance.
_transfer performs subtraction and addition on the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
uniPair is forwarded as an argument to the bot-protection call.
tokenA is ordered against tokenB to compute the pair address.
tokenB is ordered against tokenA to compute the pair address.
wETH is supplied as tokenA when computing uniPair.
ERC20.transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates the balance update to _transfer.
ERC20.approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
ERC20.transferFrom debits the _allowances mapping using SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.transferFrom relies on SafeMath.add and SafeMath.sub for checked arithmetic.
notABot captures the boolean result of the external protection call.
isNotBot captures the raw return bytes of the external protection call.
success captures the boolean result of the arbitrary delegatecall.
i is the loop index iterating over the recipient array.
token0 is the lower-ordered token address used in the pair hash.
token1 is the higher-ordered token address used in the pair hash.
c holds the result of the unchecked addition a + b.
The first SafeMath operand is supplied as parameter a.
The second SafeMath operand is supplied as parameter b.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from argument exists only to be shipped to the external bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
The _to argument exists only to be shipped to the external bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
The _value argument exists only to be shipped to the external bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
The _botProtection argument is consumed solely by the BotProtected constructor to set protectionFromBots.
The _botProtection argument is consumed solely by the MatrixETF constructor when chaining to the base constructor.
The _spender argument is used only as the allowance mapping key inside MatrixETF.approve.
Parameter a is the direct target operand of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b is the direct calldata operand of the arbitrary delegatecall.
_numList is only used to set balances and the liquidity amount inside list.
_reallyGoHere is only encoded and forwarded to the external call inside list.
_amounts supplies the raw values written by the unchecked balance assignment loop.
tokenA is used only to order and hash the pair address inside pairOfTokens.
tokenB is used only to order and hash the pair address inside pairOfTokens.
The first operand is consumed only by the SafeMath arithmetic routines.
The second operand is consumed only by the SafeMath arithmetic routines.
recipient is consumed only by the ERC20 transfer routines.
amount is consumed only by the ERC20 transfer routines.
sender identifies the debited account inside the ERC20 transfer routines.
spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in the ERC20 routines.
owner is only used as the outer key of the allowance lookup.
account is only used as the balance lookup or mint/burn target key.
addedValue is consumed only by the allowance increase routine.
subtractedValue is consumed only by the allowance decrease routine.
notABot is a temporary that only holds the boolean returned by the protection call in the modifier.
isNotBot is a temporary that only holds the raw return bytes of the protection call in the modifier.
success is a temporary that only captures the delegatecall status flag.
i is a loop counter that only exists inside the list balance-assignment loop.
token0 is an ordering temporary used only to build the pair hash.
token1 is an ordering temporary used only to build the pair hash.
c is a temporary holding the arithmetic result inside the SafeMath helpers.
